stem: What is one way that Cheval in the selection “A Legacy of Stone” and Sawadogo in the selection “Trees Rise in the Desert” are different?

options.label: A
options.text: Cheval created a new design, but Sawadogo applied an old method.

options.label: B
options.text: Cheval was not always interested in architecture, but Sawadogo was always interested in farming.

options.label: C
options.text: Cheval has inspired other artists, but Sawadogo’s work has gone unnoticed.

options.label: D
options.text: Cheval was not sure if he could finish his project, but Sawadogo knew that his experiment would be successful.
